data.name: Houghton Visitor Center
data.description: The Houghton Visitor Center is located in Houghton, Michigan. It is the mainland headquarters for Isle Royale National Park. Trip planning assistance, Ranger III tickets and information, a park store, and viewing the park film are available.
data.audioDescription: The Houghton Visitor Center is located within the Isle Royale National Park Headquarters Complex. The entrance is located off of Lakeshore Drive. The headquarters complex is gated for transportation security, and visitors may only enter when the gate is open. When open, visitors are welcome on foot, bicycle, or in a vehicle. Follow the painted arrows past several maintenance buildings, along the pier where the RANGER III ferry docks, past the visitor center, to the parking lot. Several buildings are marked as administrative offices, and the signed visitor center is located in the center of the paved entryway and parking lot. The visitor center entrance is located by the flag pole. Obtain passes, permits, and information from park rangers. Shop the Isle Royale & Keweenaw Parks Association Store. Watch the park's 25 minute orientation film. During RANGER III passenger ferry operations, the front entrance gate is closed, and vehicle and pedestrian traffic are routed down a paved bike path to a different parking lot access point. When the visitor center is closed, the entrance gates are closed.

data.directionsInfo: The Visitor Center is located on the east end of Lakeshore Dr. in downtown Houghton, MI on the Keewenaw Waterway adjacent to the historic Dee Stadium. If traveling north on US41, turn right on Lakeshore Dr. just as you enter downtown Houghton on Shelden Avenue. The turn is adjacent to the Chamber of Commerce. If traveling north on M26, merge with US41 South. As you leave downtown use the left lane to briefly return to Shelden Ave and US41 North. Then take a right turn on Lakeshore Dr.

data.name: Rock Harbor Visitor Center
data.description: The Rock Harbor Visitor Center is located in Rock Harbor on the northeast end of Isle Royale National Park. It is only accessible by boat or seaplane. Permitting and fee payment, trip planning assistance, and a park store area available.
data.audioDescription: As you arrive at the Rock Harbor Dock, the Rock Harbor Visitor Center is located at the end of the dock, beneath the breezeway, on the right hand side. It is a small building with limited occupancy. Obtain passes, permits, and information from park rangers. Shop the Isle Royale & Keweenaw Parks Association Store. The Rock Harbor Trading Post, which sells basic food and camping supplies, is located opposite the Visitor Center beneath the breezeway.

data.directionsInfo: Rock Harbor is accessible by ferry, private boat, or seaplane. The Ranger III (Houghton, MI), Isle Royale Queen IV (Copper Harbor, MI), and Voyageur II (Grand Portage, MN) boat ferries have service to Rock Harbor. Isle Royale Seaplanes (Houghton, MI and Grand Marais, MN) also has service to Rock Harbor. The Rock Harbor Visitor Center is located at the end of the main passenger ferry dock beneath the breezeway.

exceptions.name: Winter Closure and Shoulder Season Hours

operatingHours.description: Rock Harbor Visitor Center is open daily during July and August. For visiting during May, June, and September, contact the park for updated hours at (906) 482-0984. Rock Harbor's annual winter closure is from mid-September through early June

data.name: Windigo Visitor Center
data.description: The Windigo Visitor Center is located in Windigo on the southwest end of Isle Royale National Park. It is only accessible by boat or seaplane. Permitting and fee payment, trip planning assistance, a park store, and exhibits are available.
data.audioDescription: As you arrive at the Windigo Dock, the Windigo Visitor Center is located to the left of the picnic pavilion, up the hill, following the signed path. It is a large wooden building with an outdoor porch providing seating. Obtain passes, permits, and information from park rangers. Explore exhibits and shop the Isle Royale & Keweenaw Parks Association Store. Restrooms are not located in the visitor center; restrooms are located at the bottom of the hill, north of the Windigo Dock, heading down the trail towards the Washington Creek Campground.
